$schema: Tool configuration for Bitbucket MCP Server
description: Enable or disable MCP tools by setting 'enabled' to true or false

get_repository_tags.description: List recent tags for a repository

get_pull_requests.description: List pull requests for a repository

get_pull_request.description: Get details for a specific pull request

unapprove_pull_request.description: Remove approval from a pull request

request_changes_pull_request.description: Request changes on a pull request (sets status to needs work)

unrequest_changes_pull_request.description: Remove request changes status from a pull request

get_pull_request_comments.description: List comments on a pull request

add_pull_request_comment.description: Add a comment to a pull request

get_pull_request_comment.description: Get a specific comment on a pull request

update_pull_request_comment.description: Update a comment on a pull request

delete_pull_request_comment.description: Delete a comment on a pull request

resolve_pull_request_comment.description: Resolve a comment on a pull request

reopen_pull_request_comment.description: Reopen a resolved comment on a pull request

get_pull_request_diff.description: Get diff for a pull request

get_pull_request_activity.description: Get activity log for a pull request

get_pull_request_commits.description: Get commits on a pull request

get_pull_request_statuses.description: Get build/CI statuses for a pull request

get_pull_request_diffstat.description: Get file modification statistics for a pull request

get_pull_requests_pending_review.description: Get open pull requests pending review by current user

get_pull_request_patch.description: Get the patch for a pull request (git am format, disabled by default — use get_pull_request_diff for AI review)

create_draft_pull_request.description: Create a new pull request as draft

publish_draft_pull_request.description: Publish a draft pull request (convert DRAFT to OPEN)

convert_pull_request_to_draft.description: Convert an open PR to draft (NOT supported by Bitbucket API)

submit_pull_request_batch_review.description: Submit a batch review with multiple comments and optional approve/request changes

get_pull_request_review_summary.description: Get comprehensive review summary for AI-assisted code review

suggest_pull_request_reviewers.description: Suggest reviewers based on default reviewers and PR history

get_pull_request_tasks.description: List tasks on a pull request

get_pull_request_task.description: Get a specific pull request task

create_pull_request_task.description: Create a task on a pull request

get_commit_statuses.description: Get build/CI statuses for a specific commit (Jenkins, CI/CD)

list_pipeline_runs.description: List pipeline runs for a repository

get_pipeline_run.description: Get details for a specific pipeline run

get_pipeline_steps.description: List steps for a pipeline run

get_pipeline_step_logs.description: Get logs for a specific pipeline step

run_pipeline.description: Trigger a new pipeline run on a branch

get_effective_default_reviewers.description: Get effective default reviewers for a repository
